title: How to Create a Marketing Budget for Wealth Managers - Kapitalwise

facts.fact: Recent industry data, as cited on the page without a named source, shows wealth managers spend anywhere from 1% to 10% of their revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: Recent industry data shows wealth managers spend anywhere from 1% to 10% of their revenue on marketing.

facts.fact: According to a Nasdaq analysis cited by the page, the average advisor invested about $17,400 in marketing in the prior year.
facts.quote: the average advisor invested about $17,400 in marketing last year.

facts.fact: Kapitalwise states that advisors who spent strategically and leveraged technology saw acquisition costs as low as $250 per client, while others spent upwards of $2,000 per client for similar results.
